theorem proposition_19_3
    [LieAlgebra.HasTrivialRadical K L] (x : L) :
    (∃! xsn : L × L,
      IsAddJordanChevalleyDecomposition (K := K) (L := L) x xsn.1 xsn.2) ∧
    (∀ xs xn : L, IsAddJordanChevalleyDecomposition (K := K) (L := L) x xs xn →
      ∀ y : L, ⁅x,y⁆ = 0 → ⁅xs,y⁆ = 0 ∧ ⁅xn,y⁆ = 0) := by
  sorry
